additional_info.subject: RE: ID0368042-DC/Si-D/FR-[9ZIlaP]- Power Converter CanCommLoss CRM:00645000670
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0368042 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
1. Checked the converter grouping in the SCB, it looks fine as per the Flex configuration.
2. Please check if the power converter are properly connection to its shelf case.
3. Check for any loose connection of any power cable or CAN communication cables of the converter and measured the voltage across it with the help of multimeter. Check the resistance across CAN communication cables.
4. Please see to the display of the power converter whether it is OFF state or ON?
5. Try swapping the power converter with the good one and if the error flag was changed to the replaced one then we can suspect that the converter is faulty.
6. If all the steps are performed and you still see the power converter are faulty, we suggest you to replace it as we can't rework to it.
Here is the MLFB for the converter:
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
✔
Onsite Troubleshooting
✔
End Customer Communication
✔
Spare Part Ordering
✔
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vishal Dhiman
